# Business Model Risk Desk

> We do not say if you should exist. We say where this internet/app model breaks, and the plan to fix those breaks.

Public site. No auth. Assessments of live URLs are not available yet.

## Pages

- [Home](/): wordmark, promise, Start the evidence file → `/intake`. URL field (disabled; assessments next).
- [Evidence file](/intake): human questionnaire. One fact per screen. Skip means “I don’t know yet” (unknown, not no). Humans click. Agents do not walk this path.
- [Method](/method): glance object (`dominant_break`, `time_to_break`, `evidence`, `model_condition`).
- [Sample anatomy](/sample): how to read the frozen sample.
- [Sample report (HTML)](/r/sample): frozen labeled-fiction assessment of Porchlist, a fake local-services marketplace. Dominant break: You charged the homeowner without checking the worker (inferred, contingent). Charging the homeowner is merchant of record because the operator takes 100% of the payment, then pays the worker. Also: first-job check, off-platform repeat work, PSP underwrite tripwires, legal and contractable.
- [Sample report (Markdown)](/r/sample.md): the same data as markdown.

The glance object is four fields: dominant_break, time_to_break (already | this_cycle | later | unbounded_if_holds), evidence (measured | inferred | unknown), model_condition (breaking | fragile | contingent | insufficient_evidence).

## Agent intake

Agents POST facts they already have. They do not walk `/intake`.

`POST /v1/intake` with `Content-Type: application/json`:

```json
{
  "answers": [
    {
      "question_id": "q_who_pays_whom",
      "value": "take_then_pay",
      "evidence": "measured"
    }
  ]
}
```

Each answer is `question_id`, `value`, `evidence`. Omitting a field means asked is false and evidence is unknown. Skip (`"skip"`) is “I don’t know yet”: unknown, not no.

Question ids and values:

- `q_who_pays_whom`: `i_sell` | `take_then_pay` | `they_pay_provider` | `skip`
- `q_home_services`: `yes` | `no` | `skip`
- `q_statement_name`: `mine_one_stack` | `mine_bank_fbo_payouts` | `providers` | `skip`
- `q_charge_timing`: `before_exists` | `when_exists` | `after_confirm` | `skip`
- `q_time_until_exists`: `days` | `weeks` | `months` | `skip` (only if charge is before the thing exists)
- `q_when_pay_provider`: `instant_before_confirm` | `after_confirm` | `skip` (marketplace)
- `q_provider_who`, `q_provider_can`, `q_work_got_done`: `yes` | `not_yet` | `skip` (marketplace three checks)
- `q_license_at_zip`: `yes` | `not_yet` | `skip`
- `q_off_platform_repeat`: `they_leave` | `they_stay` | `skip`
- `q_who_sets_price`: `platform` | `provider` | `skip`
- `q_deposits`, `q_holding_funds`, `q_classification`: `yes` | `no` | `skip` (marketplace or home services)
- `q_negative_option`: `yes` | `no` | `skip`
- `q_cancel_path`: `yes` | `not_yet` | `skip`
- `q_tools_card`, `q_tools_payouts`, `q_tools_fraud`, `q_tools_storefront`: short text or `skip` (never set the glance)
- `q_entity`, `q_site`: short text or `skip`
- `q_refund`: `yes` | `not_yet` | `skip`
- `q_this_cycle`: `live` | `pre_launch` | `skip`

Returns `{ "report_id": "v1_…" }`. Then `GET /r/{id}` (HTML) or `GET /v1/reports/{id}` (same object as HTML). Free reports are truncated; the schema is the same.

Tools answers never set the glance. Dominant break is the first measured missing control for this money path.
